insights.one_liner: Amaris is a large international tech consultancy (7,600+ people, 110 nationalities) and IND sponsor, with an English-friendly data job in Eindhoven.

culture.text: An independent technology consulting firm founded in 2007, working in IT, telecom, life sciences and engineering.
More than 7,600 people from 110 nationalities in over 60 countries; part of Mantu, which has 12,000 people.
Staff mostly have computer science, IT or business backgrounds and work as consultants and engineers.

open.text: Amaris Netherlands B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, a mid-level data role in Eindhoven, doesn't require Dutch.
The posting draws around 200 applicants on LinkedIn, so expect heavy competition.

growth.text: Parent group Mantu says it generates €1 billion in annual revenue and serves over 1,500 organisations.
